Slide 06 · A little honesty
🏫

We weren't always this close.

School wasn't the chapter where we became close. Back then, I don't think either of us knew that, as life went on, we'd get to know each other better and become this close.

Maybe some of the best connections take their time. I'm glad ours found its way here. 🌱
OVER-SENSITIVE HEART, BEAUTIFUL SOUL 💗
Slide 07 · Then life did its thing
🌱

Somewhere along the way…

Adult life brought more conversations, unexpected laughs, shared little updates, and chances to see who we really are beyond school. Somewhere in all those ordinary moments, we started understanding each other better.

It's funny how life can surprise you: people you knew back then can become part of the days you look forward to now. 🌱✨
Slide 08 · What I value
🤝

You're someone I can be myself around.

Not because every day has to be exciting or every conversation has to be deep. It's the comfort of being able to talk, laugh at the most random things, share a thought, or just be yourself without making everything a big deal.

You bring your own mix of kindness, honesty, humour, and a little drama—and that makes you wonderfully you. I'm glad I get to know this side of you. 💛
Slide 09 · For your soft heart
🐣

You don't have to hide it.

Being sensitive isn't a flaw. It means things reach you, people matter to you, and your heart doesn't move through the world like it's made of stone.

I hope you never let the world convince you that being caring is something to be embarrassed about. It isn't.
Slide 10 · On the difficult days
🫠

You don't have to be okay all the time.

If a day feels heavy, you don't have to turn it into a joke immediately or pretend it didn't affect you. You can take your time. You can rest. You can tell someone.

I hope you give yourself the same patience you would offer a person you care about.
DRAMA LOVER · BINGE-WATCHING QUEEN 🎬
Slide 11 · A permission slip
🧸

Please be gentle with yourself.

You are allowed to learn slowly, change your mind, make mistakes, and start again. One bad day cannot cancel all the effort you've put in.

I hope your inner voice becomes a little kinder this year. You deserve encouragement from yourself, too.
A LITTLE SWEETNESS, A LOT OF PERSONALITY 🥭

One thing I really want you to know…

Helloooo..!! First of all, wishing you a happy birthday! Have a good year ahead and stress free undali, and overthinking cheydam aapesey konchem. Edaina cheppav kada, needi nuvve think cheskuntav; jera chepte telusthadi andi. Sare, elago adigina cheppav because you won't mind kada 😅🏃 And it's been almost 9–10 years we didn't speak after school. Ippudu school kuda matladale ani anaku. First netho matladindi, I guess in 2k23 ma akka pelli ki invite cheyadaniki call chesa; adi neeku gurtu ledu anuko 😅 After that, asal nenu neeku randomly WhatsApp lo message chesa one day on July 23, 2021. Dates gurtu levu naaku kuda. How ante, just chat chusa WhatsApp lo; edo Sri Lankan song baagundi pedite, “nen a language idi?” ante cheppinav. After that no chats anuko, regular ga. But somehow we became close ani nenu anukuntunna. Malli nen kaadu antav, na leg pull cheyadaniki aina 😅 Not sure how, but I had a little space with you where I can share gossips or opinions and whatever it might be. And thanks to Insta, the space where we talk more about movies/memes.. and not a request: watch the movies I tell you every time. Elago skip chestav chudakunda; eesari nundi won't talk iga... 🙅 And thanks for suggesting medicine when required, thoo. And all the best for your PG preparation, madam, and you will do good for sure. Tamar late replies ichinappudu kopam vastadi; adi kopam kado emo, just a frustrated kind. But nen cheppanu, ani chupiyanu elago. Emaina andam ante malla edchestav urike ne 😅 Ippudu idi cheppina feel aithav emo, too sensitive. I won't forget that day—chat 5 times chadivina, em rude ga matladina ani 🤐 Btw, I am not complaining, just letting you know what I observed. Ippudu tittukoku nannu lopala 😁 Emo, I just want to pull your legs when I get a chance, but return lo nannu aadukuntav 🙃 Inka chaala undi cheppedi, antha ida cheppalenu iga 🏃 Kondaritho matladithe manchiga anipistadi; ala netho matladithe manchiga anipistadi... Anyways, happy 26 and tadaaa... 🎵🎶 Budi budi adugula bujjai, ee roju puttina roju jarupukuntunna Goldie ki janmadina shubhakankshalu teliyajesthu, nuvvu ilanti puttina rojulu marenno jarupukovalani aashisthu... — Harsha 🤪😜
